content: <thought>Using the mass spectrum, the monoisotopic [M+H]+ peak is at m/z 183.0451, indicating a neutral mass of ~182.0378 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+2 ≈ 33 % of M) points to a single chlorine atom. Matching this mass with common elements (C, H, N, O, Cl) gives the molecular formula C₉H₉ClNO, which fits the exact mass (182.0373 Da) and DBE = 6.
